item.title: Entrepreneurship: Shaping the Future
item.content:encoded:
Diego Matricano, University of Campania "Luigi Vanvitelli"

This Multi-Journal Collection is a cross-disciplinary resource for researchers, practitioners, and policymakers interested in entrepreneurship as a way to address paramount global issues. The collection emphasizes the expected and realized changes as well as the implications related to entrepreneurship phenomena.

Papers featured in this collection investigate the impact of entrepreneurship with an eye toward how it can shape the future, utilizing micro, meso, and macro levels of analysis. The collection welcomes contributions that explore entrepreneurship across diverse contexts and dimensions, including international dimensions, sustainability concerns, demographic characteristics, educational aspects, and ecosystem dynamics.

Potential topics

  • Entrepreneurship as a way to address global issues
  • Impact of entrepreneurship on shaping the future
  • Micro, meso, and macro levels of analysis of entrepreneurship
  • Expected and realized changes in entrepreneurship phenomena
  • Implications of entrepreneurship phenomena
  • International entrepreneurship and globalization
  • Sustainable and green entrepreneurship
  • Female and women entrepreneurship
  • Social entrepreneurship
  • Entrepreneurship education
  • Digital entrepreneurship and digitalization
  • Startup ecosystems and entrepreneurial ecosystems
  • Entrepreneurial motivation and behavior
  • Innovation and entrepreneurship
  • Risk-taking and resilience in entrepreneurship
  • Entrepreneurial networks and ecosystems
  • SMEs and entrepreneurship
  • Circular economy and entrepreneurship
